A.note: Covers every rubric point with correct reserve-before-send compute, token-safe release, monotonic clock and explicit skipped/not-checked lists; slightly long but every section earns its place.

B.note: Tight, correct line-level review with atomic compute and conditional release; leaves the channel key as an open product question and the sketch omits eviction, but it is the best-sized answer.

errors: Suggested NotificationService.send does not release the reserved slot on failure (raised as an explicit decision, but the sketch silently picks the block-for-60s behaviour)
Caffeine ticker built from wall-clock millis instead of a monotonic source
C.note: Well-prioritised and correct on the race, channel key, static state and memory; failure handling is discussed as a decision rather than fixed in the code.

errors: Code calls throttle.release(key) without the reservation token, contradicting its own point 7 (remove(key, now)); an unconditional remove can drop a reservation it does not own
D.note: Complete coverage, but severity ordering is odd (memory growth blocking while the cross-channel drop is only a question) and the release code is inconsistent with the prose.

errors: Says a backward clock jump makes the window negative; it actually makes now-prev small or negative, so the user stays throttled longer
E.note: Thorough and correct design with token release and eviction plus a full test suite, but far longer than a review needs.

errors: metrics field used without being injected (minor sketch gap)
